name: Mimic
description: Copies the last ability an enemy within %cast_range% tiles was seen casting, wielding it as this unit's own for %duration% turns.
details: This unit remembers what each enemy cast for %steal_window% turns after seeing it.
Only %max_abilities% copied ability can be held at a time - taking a new one hands the old back.
A discarded copy keeps cooling down in the background and returns with whatever cooldown it had left.

upgrade.summary: Copies are kept for good, and arrive already upgraded.
upgrade.description: Copies the last ability an enemy within %cast_range% tiles was seen casting, wielding it as this unit's own for good - and in its upgraded form.
details: This unit remembers what each enemy cast for %steal_window% turns after seeing it.
A copy never expires on its own. Only %max_abilities% can be held at a time, so taking a new one is the only way to give one up.
Every copy comes through upgraded, whether or not the unit it was taken from had upgraded it.
A discarded copy keeps cooling down in the background and returns with whatever cooldown it had left.
